gen-gf-revalia-fs-amulya: Revalia's wide-striding, tall-bodied letters announce themselves before anything else. Revalia is built to grab attention with that open-tailed g, while Amulya, a contemporary sans-serif with generous curve gaps, simply gets on with being read.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-chillax: Revalia stands tall and spreads out, bold and a bit theatrical. Chillax, a relaxed sans-serif drawn like spaghetti with pen-lifted, unfinished loops, lends the whole thing a loose, casual spirit under the loud heading.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-synonym: Revalia is all stretch and swagger, with a tall band of lowercase. Synonym, a dependable sans with a constant, wire-thin line and open curves, would read smoothly down a page without ever tugging at the eye.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-aclonica: That open-bellied g and wide, striding stance make Revalia hard to miss. Revalia is the one to shout, while Aclonica, a sans-serif with a deep midsection and gentle stroke shift, stretches out into a steady line.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-alumni-sans: Expressive is the word for Revalia, with its tall lowercase band and open-tailed g. Alumni Sans takes the quieter job, with low ascenders and a soft contrast, while Revalia handles the loud one.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Revalia strides across the line in wide-set, tall-bodied letters, bold and expressive, with an open lower curve on its g. Alumni Sans Pinstripe tucks in tight, its curves free of stress.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC fits its characters tight, with a faint thick-thin shift and a wide mouth on each curve. And Revalia, bold and spread wide in the heading, takes all the showmanship so the text can stay tidy.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-asimovian: Tall, stretched, a little theatrical: Revalia strides wide with an open-tailed g, its lowercase rising in a high band. Asimovian sits beside it, tall-bodied and uniform, like cut ribbon.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-cal-sans: Modern and approachable, the text face runs one stroke width from a to z, with short ascenders. Cal Sans stays friendly in the text while Revalia, bold and widely spaced, takes the showy end.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-carlito: An open-tailed g and a relaxed, wide stride make Revalia bold and expressive. Carlito, a contemporary sans-serif with round, readable letters at small sizes and tight spacing, handles the quiet work while Revalia grabs the eye.
